columns.comment: Calendar month of the scored month as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01' (the month-end snapshot as of 30-Sep-2026). This view is monthly; point-in-time measures grouped by a longer period (quarter, half, fiscal year) return its last month. The latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the scored month, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

comment: Data quality of the bronze, shared and silver layers, Apr-2023 to Sep-2026: monthly DQ score per table and DQ dimension (completeness, validity, uniqueness, timeliness, consistency) as a fraction of rows passing, the previous month's score and the change, row pass rate, rules evaluated / failed, rows failed, tables below 95%, and - for the latest DQ run (Sep-2026) - the rule-level results (rule, severity, status, failed and de-duplicated rows). Explainable dips: Jun-2026 payments replay (bronze uniqueness), Feb-May 2026 KYC migration (timeliness), Aug-2026 Japan share outage (timeliness). Scores are monthly snapshots: a quarter or year returns its last month; "this month vs last" = Month = DATE'2026-09-01' with the prior-month measures. Grain: one row per month x layer-qualified table x DQ dimension (score history) plus one row per DQ rule x layer of the latest run (Sep-2026, rule results).
